author: smcarus
title: Will India's current account balance improve in 2026 compared with 2025?
summary: Give the probability that the World Bank's current account balance for India, in % of GDP, is higher (a smaller deficit or a larger surplus) for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 1 September 2027.
knownLimits: The World Bank may not have published 2026 by the settle date; then the Quest is Unresolvable.
Oil prices move India's import bill, and so this balance, more than almost anything else.
